rca_of_issue:
Critical Bug Fixes RCA:

**Bug #1 - Spese Extra values disappearing:**
Root Cause: React re-renders were clearing TextInput values because the input was directly bound to parent state (speseExtraFornitore). Every keystroke triggered a state update in parent, causing re-render and cursor/value loss.
Fix: Introduced localImporti state (line 57 in SpeseExtraModal.tsx) to store values locally during typing. Values flush to parent state only onBlur (line 200) and onClose (lines 98-103). This decouples typing from parent re-renders.
Verification: Code inspection confirms local state pattern implemented correctly with flush on blur/close.

**Bug #2 - Settings market names losing last character:**
Root Cause: Similar to Bug #1 - TextInput for market names was directly updating store state on every keystroke, causing re-renders that interrupted typing and lost the last character.
Fix: Introduced localMercatoNames state (line 273 in settings.tsx) to store market name inputs locally. Values sync to store only onBlur/onEndEditing (lines 735-750). Added onFocus to initialize local state from store value.
Verification: Code inspection confirms local state pattern with proper sync on blur/end editing.

**Bug #3 - Fuel stations not on route:**
Root Cause: Previous implementation likely searched only at departure/destination points, missing stations along the actual route.
Fix: Implemented 5-point search along route (lines 342-346 in server.py) at 10%, 30%, 50%, 70%, 90% positions between departure and destination. Search radius adapts based on route distance: max(5, min(int(route_km / 3) + 5, 15)) km (line 339). Deduplicates results by station name+address.
Verification: Backend API tests passed for 3 different routes:
  - Catania-Palermo: 3 stations found (€1.649-1.689/L)
  - Milano-Roma: Long distance route working
  - Bergamo-Brescia: Short route with 5km minimum radius

**Testing Limitations:**
Frontend UI testing blocked by onboarding flow. Language selection screen navigation buttons not accessible via standard Playwright selectors (tried: text selectors, icon names, position clicks, DOM evaluation). Previous iteration also noted this limitation. Code fixes verified by inspection as alternative verification method.
